More broadly, manufacturers like automotive companies are eyeing causal AI to predict production disruptions (e.g., anticipating which supply shortage would actually cause a line shutdown) and to plan around them​. 2. **Senzai AI (Mexico)** – Though focused on customer intelligence, its data integration platform can aid supply chain decision-makers by consolidating diverse data and using AI (including causal analysis) to optimize resource allocation​.
